capSemanticsReview.rationale: The extension-local verified MantraUSD/MYieldToOne/MExtension code exposes only immutable-SwapFacility wrap/unwrap and claimYield issuance: wrap transfers the matching M before _mint; claimYield mints at most max(M custody minus existing supply, 0). DEFAULT_ADMIN can assign freeze/yield-recipient roles, not a deposit-free minter. Parent M issuance is inherited through the serial-claim dependency, not charged again here. Proxy replacement remains an Upgrade Risk power and is not a D14 trigger.

review.evidence: Local-control review at MANTRA block 18858665, hash 0x3b827926013ded60b6eb0f1702689a63b7668ae0bb0511887dffa1cbcb4a67be, timestamp 2026-10-15T10:35:30Z. Complete explorer RoleGranted/RoleRevoked histories from block zero through this pin yielded four token grants, no token revocations, five SwapFacility grants and one revocation; pinned hasRole confirms all surviving holders and the revoked administrator. Token roles DEFAULT_ADMIN, FREEZE_MANAGER and YIELD_RECIPIENT_MANAGER are held respectively by 0x3b49208e7e831b29ea2e93fb09f315f414fd7343; 0x9cb81ad5423e0ca22d3e3af3004c85d865b70efe and 0x363c256d368277bbfaf6eaf65bee123a7adba464; and 0x50651b740e5d7b6c7c063c8618ccfc13a24b4874. The latter is also yieldRecipient(). Facility DEFAULT_ADMIN is 0xe5acad215fb9cff7823ad7d81fdd09615b93f41f; M_SWAPPER holders are 0x36f586a30502ae3afb555b8aa4dcc05d233c2ece and 0xd925c84b55e4e44a53749ff5f2a5a13f63d128fd; PAUSER is 0xf2f1acbe0ba726fee8d75f3e32900526874740bb, whose earlier DEFAULT_ADMIN was revoked. Facility paused() is false. Both token/facility proxy implementation and admin slots, ProxyAdmin owners, both Safes' full owner/threshold/module/guard/fallback census and the codeless token upgrade owner were re-read. The token admin Safe has parameter-only freeze/yield-role powers, not a minter-authorization or cap-raising path. Exact proxy source embeds a ProxyAdmin whose onlyOwner upgradeAndCall has no timelock; the token and verified facility ProxyAdmins have identical executable runtime after compiler metadata is excluded. Local wrapping transfers M before nominal child minting and claimYield mints only max(M custody minus totalSupply,0); upstream M issuance and registrar controls remain inherited. Continuous reconciliation refers only to this complete local parent-token accounting, not financial assurance of upstream reserves. Fresh M balance is 440,148.155415 against totalSupply 434,703.845695. Operational key custody and signer independence remain unknown. The rendered primary 2026-08-28 MANTRA postmortem says the native-accounting exploit did not mint new MANTRA, debit application contracts or compromise admin/governance/multisig keys; it nevertheless halted the chain for 30 hours 13 minutes. No mantraUSD mint-incident absence certificate is asserted. No transaction, execution-scope certificate or governed-issuance qualification is claimed.
